Title: Divers actes, lettres et relations des religieuses de Port-Royal du Saint Sacrement, touchant la persécution et les violences qui leur ont été faites au sujet de la signature du Formulaire
Creator: The nuns of Port-Royal du Saint-Sacrement (collective; each Relation is signed or headed by its writer), with pieces by their confessors and friends
Publisher: No place or printer legible on the title page as scanned; dated M.DCC.XXIV
Publication Date: 1724
Rights: Public Domain (published 1724, more than 95 years ago; public domain by date under the project's rolling rule; the item carries no rights field, so the date rule alone applies)
Language: fra
Source: Internet Archive item diversacteslettr00slsn (https://archive.org/details/diversacteslettr00slsn), the item's own diversacteslettr00slsn_djvu.txt full-text OCR derivative; contributing library per the item metadata: John M Kelly Library Rare Books - University of Toronto; host metadata date: 1724. Fetched directly (curl/urllib, raw bytes) by the Library thread (Era VIII pass), 2026-10-23. sha256 of the raw fetched bytes: 98e4a03af8234fb507debfd5dd528e78a4da085fa69e06ff141e7456ddb3a1d2.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; nothing else altered, no OCR error corrected, nothing retyped. University of Toronto (John M. Kelly Library rare books) scan, digitised with University of Ottawa funding; clean OCR of an old-spelling text with the long s kept as f. A few lines of manuscript annotation before the title page are garbled, and the last pages are blank-leaf noise.
Content note: The community's own dossier of the signature crisis, 1661-1665: the collective Relation of what passed at Port-Royal from April 1661, the nuns' acts and letters to the archbishop, the visitation of Péréfixe in November 1664, and the captivity Relations written by the nuns carried off to other convents, among them the Relations of the captivity of Mère Agnès Arnauld, of Mère Angélique de Saint-Jean, of Sœur Eustoquie de Brégy, of Sœur Madeleine de Sainte-Christine Briquet and others.
